title: trace_view.json
description: Normalized torch_npu.profiler chrome trace (array of events), derived from the reference sample trace_view.json.

ph.description: Chrome Trace phase: X complete, B/E begin/end, M metadata, C counter, s/f flow events.

ts.description: Timestamp in microseconds. torch_npu writes this as a decimal string.

cat.description: Category. Absent on some hardware/metadata events.

x-processes.description: Logical processes discovered via ph=M process_name / process_labels.

CANN.label: CPU
CANN.note: Node@launch.args.item_id is the kernel name used for Top-N.

Communication.label: NPU 0
Communication.note: HCCL. args carry size(Byte), bandwidth(GB/s), src/dst rank, transport type.

x-report-mapping.memory_proxy: Memcpy / empty_tensor / acl_memcpy_* events (no HBM counter in this format)
x-report-mapping.ttft_tpot: external tool via parse_metrics.py (not derivable from trace alone)
